key.name: enabled
key.description: Notifications that arrive while the display is off light the screen edges for a moment instead of turning the whole display on. Calls, alarms and other urgent pop-ups still turn it on. Do Not Disturb and bedtime decide as before: silenced notifications do not light up.

key.name: only-calls-messages
key.description: Light up only for missed calls, text messages and the apps in message-apps; other notifications behave as without edge lighting.

key.name: message-apps
key.description: Notification app names (Notify app_name, or the desktop entry) that count as messages for only-calls-messages.

key.name: color-mode
key.description: app: the main colour of the notification's icon (a stable colour per app when the icon has none); fixed: the colour key.

key.name: brightness
key.description: Panel brightness while the edges glow (1-64 of 255; also limited by battery saver's cap).

key.name: reminder-minutes
key.description: Flash again every this many minutes while notifications that lit up are still unseen (display not turned on since); 0 = never.

key.name: reminder-count
key.description: Stop reminding after this many repeats.

key.name: in-battery-saver
key.description: Off: while battery saver is on, notifications behave as without edge lighting.

key.name: preview-request
key.description: Bumped by the Settings page; Lomiri shows one glow over the screen (display on) without changing the brightness.
